replacements.old: if(-not @($snapshot | Where-Object {$_.Visible -and $_.Text.StartsWith('Image preview:')}).Count){throw 'Expected owned image renderer status.'}
replacements.new:
$statusPrefix=if($Mode -eq 'manual'){'Image preview zoom: '+$Percent+'%'}elseif($Mode -eq 'width'){'Image preview: Fit Width'}else{'Image preview: Fit'}
